name: Hel
subtitle: Queen of Helheim
description: Summon the dead to fight for you as your foes fall in battle and empower your attacks.
lore: The Lady of Graves rules over the dead of Asgard who perish of illness and old age. Hers is a joyless domain, but then, she is often a cold and pitiless goddess. But in Ryven, as she negotiates with the mysterious "Shadow Council" formed by Osiris, the lonely Hel finds herself falling in love with a most unlikely figure…
divinity_generator: Gain [50] Divinity when placing a [Curse] or [Shade].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: DMG Multiplier +30%, Ignore DEF +10%, Ignore RES +20%
Awaken the ability: The Dead that are Due
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Helheim's Hold
skills.description: Defeating an enemy increases Turn Meter Fill effects on this hero by 20% (stacking up to 5 times).
skills.awakening_bonus: Also increases Divinity Fill Effects and persists across waves.

skills.name: Grim Reception
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 375%ATK. If the target is under [Curse], inflict an additional 5% of the target’s MAX HP.
skills.awakening_bonus: If the enemy is defeated, has a 50% chance to place [Block Revive]. The chance increases by 25% for each [Shade] in the battle.

skills.name: Roots of Yggrdasil
skills.description: Attack all enemies 425%ATK with a 80% chance place [Curse II] for 2 turns.

skills.name: The Dead that are Due
skills.description: Attack all enemies 520%ATK. Revive all dead enemies and apply [Shade] on the revived enemy which cannot be resisted or blocked. Does not work on Bosses or Minions. If target is a Bosses or Minion, place [DEF Down II] on the target instead for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: [Shade] inflicts 50% more damage when joining with Hel's Basic Attack.

imprint_passive: Defeating an enemy increases Turn Meter Fill effects on this hero by 10% (stacking up to 5 times).
